details.title: A Cottage for Sale
details.lead: Willard Robison, 1930, words by Larry Conley. The chorus as it is written, with its last ending, in E♭ major: concert E♭4 to F5. Each line rises by step to a note tied over the beat, then falls back; the middle part sits high on D and E♭. In two, slow: about 92 quarter notes a minute.
